title: After pullout from YouTube, 'Drug War' series back with finale episode, awards
summary: A few weeks after the controversial crime drama “Drug War: A Conspiracy of Silence” was pulled from YouTube, its preferred platform for the six-part miniseries, it came back stronger, earning several…

blocks.text: A few weeks after the controversial crime drama “Drug War: A Conspiracy of Silence” was pulled from YouTube, its preferred platform for the six-part miniseries, it came back stronger, earning several recognitions from the Singapore-based Asian Academy Creative Awards 2026. “Drug War,” which is set to return to the platform for its sixth and last episode this week, just took home three of the four recognitions: Best Screenplay (director Shugo Praico and Jonathan Guillermo); Best Cinematography (Moises M.M. Zee); and, Best Editing (Lawrence S. Ang). READ: ‘Drug War’ series not anti-police, has nothing to do with Duterte trial — director Also […]...
